project_type: FastAPI backend + React frontend (transitioning from Jinja2/HTMX monolith)
build_system: pip for backend, npm+Vite for frontend, Docker Compose for orchestration
test_framework: pytest with TestClient for backend API tests
build_command: No explicit compile step for Python; frontend will use 'npm run build' in frontend/
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest for backend API tests. 2. Start backend with 'uvicorn app.main:app --reload'. 3. Start frontend with 'npm run dev' in frontend/. 4. Test key flows: form submission, preview, payment redirect, downloads.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None currently; frontend build output (frontend/dist/) will be generated but not checked in
environment_constraints: Stripe keys may be placeholders; payment flow must not crash. Never restart existing dev server on :9001 if running. Windows PowerShell environment.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found; follow standard FastAPI + React practices. Preserve existing solver.py, exporter.py, payments.py, storage.py, models.py, config.py unchanged. Backend must handle CORS for localhost:5173 (Vite default). Frontend must use environment variable for API base URL.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI with async/await, Pydantic models, SQLite storage via storage.py functions (create_job, find_cached_job, get_job, mark_paid). Routes return JSON or Response objects. Frontend: React 18 functional components, TailwindCSS for styling, fetch API for backend calls.
relevant_files: backend/app/storage.py (read-only: exports create_job, find_cached_job, get_job, mark_paid, record_webhook_event, webhook_event_processed, background_cleanup, initialise_storage)
backend/app/models.py (read-only: ScheduleRequest, ScheduleResult with .metrics.status, Job with .paid, Match, QualityMetrics, Venue, TimeSlot)
directory_structure: backend/ contains app/ (main.py, models.py, storage.py, solver.py, exporter.py, payments.py, config.py), tests/, static/, templates/ (will be removed), Dockerfile, requirements.txt, .env. frontend/ (new) will contain src/ with React app, package.json, vite.config.js, Dockerfile. Root has docker-compose.yml, README.md.
